_about: Everyone a slice quest places who has no quest topic of their own (owner walk 4, 2026-11-08: everyone in the places the slice quests touch has dialogue). One reply each to the prompt, built into ARG_Talk (QuestPeople in Talk.cs) gated GetIsID to the base; 'when' gates it on a quest's stage (lo inclusive, hi exclusive). Read by the echo check (tools/argonia_world/echoes.py), not the build: 'facts' lists the quest fact ids a reply states; 'speaker' names the person when a second base stands in for them elsewhere.

lines: I am Finds-The-Other-Bank. Sit quiet while Ux-Xeek calls the names.
I am Finds-The-Other-Bank. I go toward every way out I am given, for my daughter's sake.
I am Finds-The-Other-Bank. I walked here to stand beside the cutting before my colour went, and its light is out.
Ask Llarvi Maryon about the roll. I do not yet know how to get out of here.
Ri'Sakka. This one is Khajiit, a long way from the sands.
This one mends the reed sleeping mats, and is counted a hand with the gang, never kin of the families.
Ri'Sakka. This one went into the water when the huts caught fire.
This one is wet and hungry, and the mats this one patched are burnt.
Tsanji. This one carries the day's water for the families at their camp.
Tsanji. This one carried the day's water for the families.
This one has nothing to carry now, and stands here with empty hands.
Llarvi Maryon. I work at the families' camp, and I do not talk much.
Llarvi Maryon. The roll burnt in the fire, outlander.
Now nobody can show what anyone owes, not the broker and not the gang.

lines: To the camp at the end of this dock, where the families live. Keep up with the gang.

ARG_MQ01_FindsTheOtherBankMarch.speaker: Finds-The-Other-Bank
lines: I am Finds-The-Other-Bank. We are only going along the dock. I walk it for my daughter's sake.

ARG_MQ01_FindsTheOtherBankMarch.speaker: Finds-The-Other-Bank
lines: I am Finds-The-Other-Bank. The cutting's light is out, and I do not know how far the way out goes from here.
Llarvi Maryon can tell you about the roll.
I am Mee-Tuja. I carry this satchel, and I walk with the gang to the camp.
I will not say whose satchel it is.
I am Sal-Sei. I keep the clutch of eggs warm and I fetch the dry reed for the nest.
Keep wet hands off the eggs, guest.
I am Sal-Sei. The woman's two cutters cut the roots that tie the Hist cutting to the eggs.
Now the eggs are grey.
I am Sal-Sei. You came through the cutters for me. The roots were cut and the clutch is dead.
My reed-knife is yours now. I have nothing else left to give.
I am Deesh-Duun. I mend the nets at the corner of the shed, and I know every family in this camp by name.
I would like to be out of the broker's hire.
I am Deesh-Duun. The huts are burning and I am under the boards.
I cannot lift them alone.
I am Deesh-Duun. You came into the fire for me.
I saw her face: a tall woman with a knotted cord at her wrist. She took the courier's satchel and nothing else.
I am Deesh-Duun. You came for me when the huts burned, and I am alive because of it.
The woman who led them wore a knotted cord at her wrist, and I saw her face. The satchel was all she took.
I am Nesh-Neel. I walk the families' camp at dusk, and I check the huts on the water and the shed door.
You do not need my name.
I am Salts-The-Catch. I sell fish in Lilmoth, and I keep this house. If you were sent for, go in. If you were not, go back to the dock.
You do not know me. We take the hurt to Lilmoth by boat. Speak to the one beside me when you are ready to go.
Hides-His-Wake. I work this camp, and I do not talk about it with strangers. Go back the way you came.
Counts-The-Jars. I tend the jars of sap at this camp. You have no business here. Go.
I work for the estate. I walk this landing at night. The landing belongs to the estate. So do the boats tied to it. Keep walking.
I keep this gate for the heirs. The stone house is their outer post. Third-Born Tsaxi says who goes in. Speak to him.
I am a lookout. I watch the stair and the water. If you have business here, talk to Bent-Spine, not to me.
I am a lookout. I watch the water. If you came down the trapdoor, Bent-Spine has been told.
I walk the dock and count the crates in the ship's hold. When the keeper says go, I go.
